translations./garage/brief: This forklift blocks the same corridor for several seconds. When more compute cannot create a safe opening, waiting for one is the fastest plan.
translations./prediction/hint: Record a prediction. It does not affect the score; the run will give you evidence to test it.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: Use prediction; depart when the corridor opens
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Correct. Prediction, waiting, and merging are one maneuver. The shadow evaluation estimates the earliest safe departure.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Wait until the forklift is completely gone
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: That waits too long. Depart as soon as the corridor becomes safely passable; complete clearance wastes time.
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: The default build replaces a 7 s wait with a close pass, leaving only 0.15 m clearance and losing the safety badge.
